articles.title: King's Handwritten Speech Draft Goes on Show for the First Time
articles.summary: The only known draft of Martin Luther King Jr.'s famous 1963 speech is on display in Atlanta through Sunday. The draft does not include the words "I Have a Dream" — King made them up on the spot.

articles.title: Plan to Pick Presidents by Popular Vote Nears a Big Step
articles.summary: A plan to give electoral votes to the nationwide popular-vote winner now has 222 electoral votes behind it. Five more states could push it past 270, but legal hurdles remain.

articles.title: After a Week of Outages, More Americans Are Stocking Up — Just in Case
articles.summary: Recent tech outages have more people learning from "preppers." Experts say the smart move is to prepare for the risks where you live, not panic-buy.
